rationale: Search endpoint; returns data and does not mutate NExtSEEK state.

Retrieve/export sample metadata by UID or SEEK ID (incl. parent/child lineage) via dbsample.searchAdvanced; read-only. POST carries the identifier list, not a mutation. Verified non-mutating in AdminSampleViewSet.admin_retrieve_samples.
Find parent samples with derived samples of all specified child types; read-only search. POST carries the type list. Verified non-mutating in SamplesByChildTypesViewSet.parents_by_child_types.
Return full parent/child lineage trees for a list of sample identifiers (Neo4j read); read-only. POST carries the identifier list. Verified non-mutating in EntityTreeViewSet.lineage.
Dry-run validation of a batch-upload workbook; parses and validates only, no DB commit (unlike batch-upload/start). Read-only. Verified non-mutating in BatchUploadViewSet.validate.
Download a data file (or zip of files) by identifier; read-only export. POST carries the identifier list. Verified non-mutating in DataFileViewSet.download.
Download an SOP file (or zip) by identifier; read-only export. POST carries the identifier list. Verified non-mutating in SopViewSet.download.
List investigations; read-only GET (sibling of the already-allowlisted samples/projects/assays lists).
List people; read-only GET (sibling of the already-allowlisted samples/projects/assays lists).
List SOPs; read-only GET (sibling of the already-allowlisted samples/projects/assays lists).
